::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 5th 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 61
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I am afraid the last 3d of the [Primer](cmy_books/cmybook_353.qmd) is lost. I will re write it after my outing. Happily it is only 40 pp at most - I hope waiting will not be troublesome. Here is another instalment of  '[The Story of the Christians and Moors in Spain](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd)'

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
